description: Shams Textile Mills Limited was founded in 1968 and began as a composite facility covering spinning, weaving, dyeing and finishing, before narrowing its focus to yarn. It now spins export-quality cotton yarn - carded, combed, multi-count, multi-twist, slub and compact - in counts from 6/s to 60/s, and has built a dedicated unit with capacity of 816,480 kg a month for multi-count, multi-twist and slub yarns. The company also describes work on recycled-material yarns as part of its production.
headOffice: 8th Floor, Tricon Corporate Center, 73-E, Main Jail Road, Gulberg II, Lahore, Pakistan
